def render_header(targets: List[Path], is_system_scan: bool) ->Text:
    version = get_safety_version()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    timestamp = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
    
    if is_system_scan:
        header_line = f"Safety {version} running system scan"
    else:
        if targets:
            target_paths = ", ".join(t.as_posix() for t in targets)
            header_line = f"Safety {version} scanning {target_paths}"
        else:
            header_line = f"Safety {version} scanning "
    
    return Text(f"{header_line}\n{timestamp}")
